2607.13389.title: Where Should RL Post-Training Compute Go? Model Size, Search, Learning, and Feedback
2607.13389.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training is increasingly used to adapt foundation models for reasoning, planning, and feedback-driven robot-learning pipelines, but constrained post-training resources are often summarized by a single total FLOP budget. We study the fixed-budget decision problem behind this practice: under the same post-training budget, should one use a larger policy, train a smaller policy longer, generate more rollout search, or spend compute on stronger reward feedback? We introduce a FLOP-accounting framework for GRPO post-training that decomposes compute into rollout/search, policy-update/learning, and reward- or feedback-model evaluation. Across LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5 policies, we find conditional allocation frontiers: the best observed allocation changes with model size, compute budget, reward system, and evaluation target. Same-FLOP model-size comparisons show that model choice and training allocation are coupled because larger policies consume more per-token compute and therefore buy fewer updates or rollouts under the same budget. Reward systems also change the accounting: rule-based rewards spend nearly all non-update compute on policy rollouts, while PRM-style feedback allocates a visible part of the budget to reward-model inference. We present RACE as a diagnostic pilot-grid protocol, not a guarantee of held-out improvement, for identifying allocation regimes before expensive validation runs; our results suggest that RL post-training papers should report total FLOPs together with how compute is divided among model size, search, learning, and feedback.
2607.13389.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）後訓練越來越多地用於調整基礎模型以進行推理、規劃和基於反饋的機器人學習管道，但受限的後訓練資源通常被總結為單一的總 FLOP 預算。我們研究這一做法背後的固定預算決策問題：在相同的後訓練預算下，應該使用更大的策略、將較小的策略訓練更長時間、生成更多的展開搜索，還是將計算資源用於更強的獎勵反饋？我們引入了一個 FLOP 計算框架，用於 GRPO 後訓練，將計算分解為展開/搜索、策略更新/學習，以及獎勵或反饋模型評估。在經過 LoRA 調整的 Qwen2.5 策略中，我們發現條件分配邊界：最佳觀察到的分配隨著模型大小、計算預算、獎勵系統和評估目標而變化。同 FLOP 模型大小比較顯示，模型選擇和訓練分配是相互關聯的，因為較大的策略每個標記消耗更多的計算資源，因此在相同預算下購買的更新或展開更少。獎勵系統也改變了計算：基於規則的獎勵幾乎將所有非更新計算用於策略展開，而 PRM 風格的反饋則將預算的一部分分配給獎勵模型推理。我們提出 RACE 作為一種診斷性試點網格協議，而不是保證持有改進的方式，用於在昂貴的驗證運行之前識別分配模式；我們的結果表明，RL 後訓練論文應報告總 FLOP 以及計算如何在模型大小、搜索、學習和反饋之間分配。
